description: This file defines a command class ResetSupersetCommand that performs a factory reset of the Superset application by deleting various database records, excluding certain users and roles, and logging the reset action.

classes.name: ResetSupersetCommand
classes.description: A command class to reset the Superset application by deleting data and logging the reset.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the reset command with user confirmation, user info, and optional exclusions for users and roles.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the reset can proceed, checking confirmation and user activity.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the reset process: deletes data, excludes certain users and roles, and logs the reset action.
